entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What... What am I saying? I've barely[n]even talked to you before...
entries.uk: Що... Що це я кажу? Я ж із тобою[n]майже й не говорила раніше...

entries.en: It's fine.
Maybe that's why?
Sorry for butting in...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...You might be right.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No... This was all my fault.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...You're so weird. Usually everyone just[n]ignores me.
entries.uk: ...Ти такий дивний. Зазвичай мене[n]всі просто ігнорують.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Are you really a bad person? I've heard[n]people talking about you, but... I just don't[n]see it.
entries.uk: Ти справді погана людина? Я чула, що[n]про тебе кажуть, але... щось я цього[n]не бачу.

entries.en: I'm bad to the bone.
What are they saying?
entries.uk: І що ж про мене кажуть?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Is that supposed to be a joke?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That you assaulted someone...[n]That you almost killed them...
entries.uk: Що ти на когось напав...[n]Що мало не вбив...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I kinda had a feeling they were all just[n]exaggerations.
entries.uk: Мені якось здавалося, що це все[n]перебільшення.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You seemed lonely—almost like you[n]didn't belong anywhere...
entries.uk: Ти здавався самотнім — ніби тобі[n]ніде немає місця...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We're the same in that regard. Maybe[n]that's why it was so easy for me to talk[n]to you.
entries.uk: У цьому ми схожі. Може, тому мені[n]було так легко з тобою[n]говорити.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Is there really no way for me to help[n]Shiho?
entries.uk: Невже я ніяк не можу допомогти[n]Сіхо?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I wish he'd just change his mind...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Like, forget about me, and everything...
entries.uk: Ну, забув про мене і все таке...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: As if something like that would ever[n]happen...
That's too convenient.
It could happen.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I wasn't asking for a serious response.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But I do feel a bit better now.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...I'm gonna head home.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Don't tell anyone what I told you, okay?
entries.uk: Нікому не кажи, що я тобі розповіла, гаразд?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'll try and think of a way to persuade[n]Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well... thanks.
